# Telegram WebApp SDK

`telegram-web-app.js` is the unmodified official browser SDK fetched from https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js?63 on 2026-09-05.

It ships with the application so Telegram's ready handshake does not depend on a second, external script request. Keep vendor source intact; the 500-line authored-module rule does not apply to this upstream file. Refresh deliberately and run Telegram boot tests when updating.
